# Free Energy Principle

Organisms minimise variational free energy; see
[[mathematics/markov_blanket|Markov Blanket]] and [[mathematics/bayesian_networks]].

A transition matrix literal inside a code fence must not become a link:

```math
A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
```

Outside a fence the single-row form [[1, 2]] would otherwise match the
wiki-link pattern, and the multi-row matrix [[1, 2], [3, 4]] must not either.

Inline code `[[fake_inline_target]]` is ignored as well.

The dangling concept [[cognitive/missing_concept]] is recorded as unresolved.
